parameters.note: Overall product width, outer faces of the side panels. Customers choose only customerValues (staff: free min..max). Standard sizes (D-7): industry-common wardrobe sizes, unconfirmed until Dafna confirms its range.

Overall product height from the floor, plinth included. Customers choose only customerValues. Standard sizes (D-7): industry-common wardrobe sizes, unconfirmed until Dafna confirms its range. D-17 (founder, 2026-11-16): Dafna's maximum wardrobe height is 2200 mm; customer heights 2000 / 2100 / 2200.

Overall outer depth: back panel + carcass + front door gap + door (ADR-003). Default 600 (D-1c, unconfirmed): carcass 579 with doors, so rail presets (>= 530 inner depth) are available at the default size. Customers choose 600 (hanging clothes: inner depth >= 560, GOST 13025.1-85) or 450 (shelves / drawers only). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).
auto = minimum section count that keeps each section inner width <= maxShelfSpanMm.
Carcass, partition and plinth board (LDSP only). Its thickness drives all carcass geometry. Decors = Dafna price list (catalog 1.0.0), colours unconfirmed.
'same_as_corpus' = door decor follows corpusMaterial. Door thickness = this material's thickness (LMDF 16 / 16.7 mm: doors only).

D-26 (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right): HDF 3 mm in a groove backGrooveFromRearMm from the rear edge, entering every panel by backGrooveDepthMm (option id kept).

D-26 (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right): feet = four 20 mm "Bingo" feet, the full-width bottom on them and the sides between bottom and top (no plinth); plinth = the D-3a.1 construction (sides to the floor, strips between them). Assumed: setback of the front plinth strip from the carcass front edge. Back strip is never recessed. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Preset for all sections. auto: single door if the single-leaf width (coverage minus gaps) <= maxSingleLeafWidthMm, else double. Single doors hinge toward the outer side of their half (ADR-006 rev. D-1c).

D-22 (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): two door mountings to choose from. overlay (nakladnoy) = doors cover the carcass front; inset (vkladnoy) = doors sit inside the openings, flush with the carcass front, insetDoorGapMm all round and between leaves; the depth stack is then back + carcass (no door in front of the carcass). D-26: inset is the default (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right: every door in the Bazis models is inset). D-27: inset leaves span the partitions between doored sections (the partitions stand behind them).

maxShelfSpanMm.note: Assumed maximum section inner width before shelves sag (SHELF_SPAN warning, sections=auto).

backMaterial.note: Assumed back panel material (catalog id). Its thickness is the back thickness.

doorGapFrontMm.note: Assumed gap between the carcass front edge and the back face of the overlay door. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

doorGapBetweenMm.note: Assumed gap between two adjacent door leaves. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

doorGapEdgeMm.note: Assumed gap between a door leaf and the outer carcass edge (left, right, top, bottom). Also used next to a section without a door. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): 3 mm

maxSingleLeafWidthMm.note: Assumed maximum width of one door leaf. Single source for doors=auto (single vs double) and DOOR_TOO_WIDE; measured on the leaf, not the section opening. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): 500 mm

doorLeafRoundingMm.note: Assumed rounding step for door leaf widths; the remainder goes to the leaves that lost most by rounding so leaves + gaps = covered width exactly. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): answer "0" (no half millimetres) = leaf widths in whole millimetres

insetDoorGapMm.note: Gap around and between inset door leaves (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

maxDoorHeightMm.note: Assumed door height above which DOOR_TOO_HEIGHT warns (warping risk).

shelfPitchTargetMm.note: Assumed target pitch of removable shelves; the count is derived from the available height (compartments = round(height / pitch)), openings are equal.

shelfFrontSetbackMm.note: Assumed setback of shelves from the carcass front (removable shelves); shelf depth = carcass inner depth - setback. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): shelves 20 mm behind the carcass front (inset doors: behind the door)

insetShelfSetbackMm.note: Shelves behind an inset door: 1 mm behind the door (17 mm from the carcass front) (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

openShelfSetbackMm.note: Shelves of an open section (no door): 5 mm from the carcass front (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

railTopShelfDropMm.note: Assumed distance from the carcass top inner face down to the top face of the shelf above a rail (rail presets). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): 200 mm

railAxisDropMm.note: Assumed distance from the underside of the shelf/top above a rail down to the rail axis.

drawerFrontHeightMm.note: Assumed internal drawer front height. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

drawerCountPerSection.note: Assumed number of internal drawers per drawer preset, stacked at the bottom of the section.

drawerGapMm.note: Assumed vertical gap below, between and above internal drawer fronts (drawer zone = gap + count x (front + gap)). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

drawerFrontSetbackMm.note: Assumed setback of internal drawer fronts behind the carcass front edge (they sit behind the doors). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): 20 mm (inset doors: behind the door)

drawerSlideClearanceMm.note: Assumed slide clearance per side: drawer box width = section inner width - 2 x 13. Internal fronts are as wide as the box (simplified). Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: depends on the slide model - to come with the hardware list.

drawerBoxHeightReductionMm.note: Drawer box height is 120 mm (front 170 - 50) (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

drawerBackClearanceMm.note: Assumed free space behind a drawer box. Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: depends on the slide model - to come with the hardware list.

drawerSlideMinMm.note: Assumed shortest slide; box depth = longest slide (250..550, 50 steps) that fits.

railMinDepthMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», drawings 1-2: clothing compartment depth >= 560 mm (RAIL_DEPTH_SHORT below). Was 530 (assumed) up to template 0.6.0.

railMinHangingHeightMm.note: Assumed minimum clear hanging height under a rail (RAIL_HEIGHT_SHORT warning below).

drawerMaxFrontWidthMm.note: Assumed maximum internal drawer front width (DRAWER_SECTION_TOO_WIDE warning above).

edgeBandId.note: Visible edges: PVC 1 mm x 19 ("Кромка 1/19"): doors and fronts all round, top / bottom front and ends (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

edgeBandThicknessMm.note: Thick edge band thickness (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

edgeBandThinId.note: Less visible edges: 0.4 mm x 19 ("Кромка 19,04"): sides front and back, partitions and shelves (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

edgeBandThinMm.note: Thin edge band thickness (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

railTopMaxMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», cl. 2.3: rail top edge at most 1900 mm from the floor (higher only with a pull-down rail).

railTopToShelfMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», drawings 1-2: >= 50 mm from the rail top to the shelf above. 60 chosen for hanger hooks (unconfirmed).

longHangMinMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», drawing 1 (coats, dresses): >= 1400 mm from the rail top to the element below.

shortHangMinMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», drawing 2 (suits, jackets, shirts): >= 900 mm from the rail top to the element below.

shortHangClearMm.note: Short-clothes hanging zone actually planned above the shelves (>= 900 by GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения»); 1000 = margin for longer jackets (unconfirmed).

drawerTopMaxMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», cl. 7: top drawer edge at most 1250 mm from the floor (DRAWER_TOO_HIGH above).

minShelfGapMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения», cl. 3.1: clear gap between shelves >= 170 mm; smaller leftovers get no shelf / antresol.

autoPresetDouble.note: 'auto' fill behind a double door: short clothes + shelves (D-7, unconfirmed).

autoPresetSingle.note: 'auto' fill behind a single door or without a door: shelves (unchanged).

bookGapMinMm.note: D-14: target clear gap of open book / document shelves, so an A4 folder stands upright (A4 = 297 mm, ISO 216; lever-arch files ~320 mm high). Inside the GOST 13025.1-85 table 2 range (180..390 mm).

bookGapMaxMm.note: GOST 13025.1-85 table 2 (books): clear gap between shelves 180..390 mm; depth 140..440 mm.

splitCarcassFromWidthMm.note: D-15 (founder's decision, 2026-11-14): from this width the wardrobe is made as two carcasses side by side, split at the middle boundary (sections 1+1, 2+1, 2+2): each carcass has its own sides, top, bottom, back and plinth strips. Easier to carry and assemble; ~1 side panel more board.

feetHeightMm.note: Bingo feet height (FN004 "Бинго 2 см") (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

feetInsetMm.note: Feet centre from the carcass corners (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

backGrooveFromRearMm.note: Back groove distance from the rear edge of sides, top and bottom (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

backGrooveDepthMm.note: How far the back enters each panel (back = inner size + 2 x 8) (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right).

insetPartitionBehindDoorMm.note: A partition hidden behind inset doors: its front edge 1 mm behind the doors, as the shelves (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md: Offis 377.5 mm leaves, sectional pedestal 3 mm between leaves), founder 2026-11-23).

constructionRules.note: D-26 (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md), founder 2026-11-23: Bazis is right): top and (on feet) bottom full width, sides between them; back HDF in a groove (partitions stop at its front face); removable shelves 1 mm short each side, banded all round; two edge bands (1 mm visible, 0.4 mm others); drawer boxes 120 mm high.

D-27 (Dafna's Bazis models (docs/production/bazis/ANALIZ.md: Offis 377.5 mm leaves, sectional pedestal 3 mm between leaves), founder 2026-11-23): inset doors close a whole run of doored sections as one opening - the leaves meet with insetDoorGapMm between them and no partition shows between them. A partition between two doored sections stands behind the doors (door thickness + insetPartitionBehindDoorMm shorter at the front); next to an open section, a books_lower section or at a carcass split it stays full depth and frames the opening. A leaf hinging on a hidden partition is half overlay on it.

CONFIRMED by Dafna (D-3a.1): side panels run the full product height to the floor (base = plinth or none). The carcass bottom rests on the plinth strips at plinthHeight; carcass height (top of bottom board to top) = height - plinthHeight. D-26: only with base = plinth; on feet the sides stand on the bottom.

D-22 CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23): the top lies ON the side panels (length = carcass width, its ends are visible and banded); the bottom stays BETWEEN the sides (length = carcass width - 2 x panelThickness). Side height = height - panelThickness. Was: top and bottom between the sides (templates up to 0.11.0).
Sections share the inner width equally in whole millimetres; any remainder (< sections mm) goes +1 mm to the leftmost sections. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

CONFIRMED by Dafna (D-3a.1): plinth = front and back strips BETWEEN the side panels (length = width - 2 x panelThickness, height = plinthHeight, board thickness = panelThickness). Front strip set back by plinthRecess from the carcass front, back strip flush with the carcass back. plinthHeight / plinthRecess values stay unconfirmed.
Vertical partitions are fitted between top and bottom and run the full carcass depth. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).
depth = back + carcass + (doors ? doorGapFront + door : 0). carcassDepth = depth - back - (doors ? door + doorGapFront : 0). Decided in D-1a (ADR-003).
The overlay back covers the carcass only (width x carcass height), not the plinth. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).
The front plinth strip is set back from the carcass front (not from the door) by plinthRecess. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Doors are overlay (nakladnye): they cover the carcass front. Height = carcass height - 2 x doorGapEdge; the plinth stays visible. D-22: or inset (doorMount = inset): leaves inside the section opening, flush with the carcass front, height = carcass inner height - 2 x insetDoorGapMm. CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).

Door coverage of a section ends at the centre line of its partitions (outer carcass edge for the end sections); a double door splits its coverage in two leaves. Leaf widths are rounded to doorLeafRoundingMm (ADR-006). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).
interior 'auto': single door -> shelves, double door -> rail_shelf, no door -> shelves; if that preset would produce a warning (e.g. rail in a shallow carcass), shelves instead.

Drawers stack at the bottom of the section with a fixed shelf directly above; rail presets put a top shelf 400 mm below the top inner face and the rail axis 60 mm below the shelf (or the top); remaining free space without a rail gets evenly spaced removable shelves.

Visible front edges are banded (sides, partitions, top, bottom, shelves: local front edge; doors and drawer fronts: all four edges); back, plinth, drawer box parts: no band. D-22: every visible edge is banded - with the top on the sides, also the top ends (not where two carcasses meet). CONFIRMED (Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23).
grainDirection = 'length' for LDSP/MDF parts, null for HDF; real grain rules need Dafna data (oak decors). Dafna technologist, confirmation table 2026-11-23: grain is set by the manager per material.

Single doors hinge toward the outer side of their half of the wardrobe: 1: L, 2: L,R, 3: L,L,R, 4: L,L,R,R (middle of an odd count: left). Two leaves may hinge on the same partition (half-overlay hinges on both faces); they cannot both be fully open at once.
hingeMount per leaf: 'full_overlay' when hinged on an outer side panel, 'half_overlay' when hinged on a partition (each leaf covers half the partition). Data only, for later hardware / export.
sections=auto picks the smallest count that keeps every section inner width <= maxShelfSpanMm and, unless doors=none, no single leaf wider than maxSingleLeafWidthMm (relevant for doors=all_single).

D-7: long_hang / short_hang / short_hang_drawers follow GOST 13025.1-85 «Мебель бытовая. Функциональные размеры отделений для хранения»: rail top <= 1900 from the floor and >= 50 below the shelf above; >= 1400 (long) / >= 900 (short) below the rail top; inner depth >= 560 for a rail; top drawer edge <= 1250; shelves >= 170 apart; space above the rail that fits a >= 170 compartment becomes an antresol (rarely used items, GOST table 6 note).
